verdict.rationale: The evidence documents instant AI summaries, custom summaries, AI action items and a conversational assistant. None of it mentions drafting a follow-up email for the user to review and send. Summaries and action items are adjacent features, not the follow-up email drafting capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks
